name: Hotel Post
beschreibung: Hotel Post is situated in St. Jakob am Arlberg near St. Anton in Tyrol's Landeck district. The property's historic heritage lends it a distinct and inviting alpine character. In winter, guests enjoy effortless access to the expansive slopes of Ski Arlberg, while summer opens up scenic alpine hiking paths. Amenities include an upscale wellness area with an indoor pool and sauna, an à-la-carte restaurant serving regional specialties, and cozy rooms.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Post in St. Jakob am Arlberg features historic charm, an indoor pool and sauna, fine Tyrolean dining, and direct connectivity to Ski Arlberg.
